note: Community tab. `givenTotalUSD` is a config constant that starts at zero — the app makes no claim about money given until money has been given, and the card shows it honestly as $0. `totalGivenUSD` is the Phase-1 spelling of the same number, kept as an alias so Tests/StudyContentTests/BundledJSONTests.swift still decodes; the two must stay equal and FeatureCommunityTests asserts that. Votes are stored locally in prefs.json; there is no server. `image` is the artwork slug in App/Assets.xcassets (`Charity-<image>`); no real logos are bundled.
headline: Given to charities
subline: Every subscription gives a share back to the Ummah.
voteBody: A portion of all proceeds across the entire app goes to one of these charities each month. Subscribers get one vote to choose who receives it.

organisations.name: Islamic Relief Worldwide
organisations.blurb: Islamic Relief Worldwide was founded in Birmingham in 1984 and now works in more than 40 countries, from emergency response after disasters to long-term water, health and livelihood programmes. It works through its own country offices and local partners rather than parachuting in.

organisations.name: Penny Appeal
organisations.blurb: Penny Appeal started in Wakefield in 2009 on a simple idea: small, regular donations, pooled together, go further than occasional large ones. Those pennies fund water projects, orphan care and food programmes across Asia, Africa and the Middle East, plus emergency appeals when they are needed.

organisations.name: Human Appeal
organisations.blurb: Human Appeal was founded in Manchester in 1991 and works across the Middle East, Africa and South Asia on health, education and livelihood programmes alongside emergency response. It publishes country-level reporting, so it is possible to see where the money went.
